title: Mount Pinatubo erupts in the Philippines
summary: The climactic eruption of Mount Pinatubo on Luzon threw ash and gas into the stratosphere, while a typhoon turned the ash into heavy mud.
reason: The volcano had been dormant for about 500 years before magma rose in early 1991.
significance: Timely evacuations saved thousands, and its aerosols cooled the global climate by about half a degree.
participants: Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology
